definition.name: Captured Cargo Git offline components and signed execution

steps.name: Install the existing bounded compiler namespace and pinned bindings
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Download only this run's identity-checked public prerequisites
Test Git source admission and prepared artifact refusal controls
Compile the captured unchanged Git crate offline and execute signed components
Retain bounded Git component qualification observations including failures

with.name: rust-git-components-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/capture.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/offline.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/first/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/first/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/first/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/first/component.wit
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/offline-rebuild/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/offline-rebuild/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/offline-rebuild/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/offline-rebuild/component.wit
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-git-components/node/FAILED.json

reviewReason: Separate bounded signed Git component job consumes this run exact public prepared tuple; no native rebuild, existing authority and resource limits retained.
